# Events

Events and other top-level lines: what starts a trigger. 169 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Advancement done {#advancement_done}

```carve
on advancement done
```

A player completes an advancement. Has `player`.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Armor change {#armor_change}

```carve
on armor change
```

A player puts on, takes off or swaps armor. `event-slot` (helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots), `event-item` and `past event-item`. Checked every 4 ticks while a script uses it.

```carve
on armor change:
    send "%event-slot% changed" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-step-jump](../syntax/events-step-jump.md)

## Block break {#break}

```carve
on break
on break of <block>
on block break
on mine
```

A block is broken. `on break of stone or oak log` only runs for those blocks. Has `player` (`<none>` when no player broke it) and `event-block`, the broken block. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on break of stone or oak log:
    send "You mined %event-block%." to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Click {#click}

```carve
on click
on (right click|rightclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
on (left click|leftclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
```

A player clicks air or a block. `with` checks the held item, `on` the clicked block, in any order. Has `clicked block` (also `event-block`). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on right click with blaze rod:
    send "Whoosh!" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Command {#command}

```carve
command [/]<name> [<type>] [[<type>]]
```

Adds a script command. Entries: `permission:`, `description:` and the required `trigger:`. Argument types: `<text>`, `<number>`, `<player>`; `[ ]` makes one optional. New commands need a server restart.

```carve
command /greet <player> [<text>]:
    permission: greet
    trigger:
        send "%player% says hi!" to arg-1
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [commands](../commands.md)

## Command (event) {#command-event}

```carve
on command
on command "<name>"
on player command
```

A player runs any command. `command` is the command name, `full command` the whole text without the slash. `cancel event` stops the command. With a name (`on command "home":`) it only runs for that command; a name with a space compares the full command.

```carve
on command:
    if command is "op":
        cancel event
        send "No." to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-movement](../syntax/events-movement.md)

## Damage {#damage}

```carve
on damage
on damage of %entity type%
on player damage
```

A player or mob takes damage. `on damage of player` / `on damage of zombie` run for that victim type only. Has `damage` (settable), `damage cause`, `attacker` (a player or entity, `<none>` for falls and the like) and `victim`; `player` is `<none>` when the victim is a mob. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on damage of zombie:
    if attacker is a player:
        add 2 to damage
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Death {#death}

```carve
on death
on death of player
on player death
```

A player or a mob dies. Has `victim` (the one that died), `player` (unset for mobs), `death message` (settable, players only) and `attacker`: the last player or entity that hit them in the 5 seconds before, else `<none>`. Cancelling a player's death stops Pumpkin's death handling but leaves 0 health.

```carve
on death of player:
    broadcast "%player% died"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Death of a mob {#mob_death}

```carve
on death of %entity type%
```

A mob or player of that type dies (`on death of zombie`). Plain `on death` runs for mobs too, with `player` unset; use `victim` for the one that died. `attacker` is the last player or entity that hit it in the 5 seconds before.

```carve
on death of zombie:
    broadcast "%victim% died"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Move {#move}

```carve
on move
on player move
on walk
```

A player moves into another block (turning the head or moving inside a block does not count). `event-location` is where to, `past event-location` where from. Can be cancelled. Needs a server restart when the first `on move` script is added.

```carve
on move:
    if y of event-location < 0:
        teleport player to spawn of world "world"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-movement](../syntax/events-movement.md)


A block of named constants, used as `{@name}` anywhere in the same file.

```carve
options:
    prefix: &8[&6Shop&8]&r
on join:
    send "{@prefix} Welcome" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## Placeholder request {#placeholder_request}

```carve
on placeholder request for prefix "<prefix>"
on placeholder request
```

Someone asks for the placeholder `%<prefix>_<identifier>%`. `the identifier` is the text after the prefix and `the prefix` is the prefix. Answer with `set the result to ...`; if nothing sets it, the placeholder stays as written. Without `for prefix` the trigger sees every placeholder that is not built in.

```carve
on placeholder request for prefix "shop":
    if the identifier is "coins":
        set the result to "%{coins::%player%} ? 0%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [placeholders](../syntax/placeholders.md)
